message:
## Vulnerability Digest

The 24-hour window was **2026-08-26 05:10 IST to 2026-08-27 05:10 IST**. High-confidence activity comprised **23 newly disclosed Ubiquiti CVEs** plus **two new Ubuntu security notices covering 10 previously disclosed CVEs**. Immediate review is recommended for Ubiquiti/UniFi deployments because most of the new issues are rated Critical.

**Finding 1: EdgeMAX EdgeSwitch remote code execution**

- Product: Ubiquiti EdgeMAX EdgeSwitch
- Issue: CVE-2026-77532
- Severity: Critical, CVSS 9.6
- Summary: An adjacent-network attacker can exploit a DHCPv6 buffer overflow to execute code on affected switches.
- Relevance: Ubiquiti/UniFi is explicitly monitored.
- Affected/fixed: Versions before 1.12.2; fixed in 1.12.2.
- Source: [CVE record](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-77532)

**Finding 2: UniFi Protect Application command injection**

- Product: UniFi Protect Application
- Issues: CVE-2026-77533, CVE-2026-77537, CVE-2026-77548
- Severity: Critical, CVSS 9.9 to 10.0
- Summary: Network-accessible input-validation flaws allow command execution on the host; two paths require low privileges and one requires no stated privileges.
- Relevance: These are official UniFi components under the monitored Ubiquiti/UniFi family.
- Affected/fixed: Versions before 7.2.105; fixed in 7.2.105.
- Source: [Ubiquiti Security Advisory Bulletin 067](https://community.ui.com/releases/r/security/067)

**Finding 3: UniFi OS privilege escalation and authentication bypass**

- Product: UniFi OS on Cloud Keys, gateways, Dream Machines/Routers/Wall, NVR/ENVR, NAS/ENAS, Enterprise Firewall Core, Express, and related consoles
- Issues: CVE-2026-77534, CVE-2026-77536, CVE-2026-77545, CVE-2026-77549, CVE-2026-77550
- Severity: Critical, CVSS 9.0 to 10.0
- Summary: The issues enable low-privilege escalation, escalation through active debug code under stated conditions, and CRLF-based authentication bypass.
- Relevance: The advisory explicitly covers the monitored UniFi product family.
- Affected/fixed: Product-specific fixes include UniFi OS 5.1.31, OS Server 5.1.37, NAS 5.1.32, and Express 4.0.17.
- Source: [Ubiquiti Security Advisory Bulletin 067](https://community.ui.com/releases/r/security/067)

**Finding 4: UniFi Network Application command injection and privilege escalation**

- Product: UniFi Network Application
- Issues: CVE-2026-77535, CVE-2026-77541
- Severity: Critical, CVSS 9.1
- Summary: A network attacker with high privileges can execute commands on an adopted device or escalate privileges inside the application.
- Relevance: UniFi Network is an official component of the monitored Ubiquiti/UniFi family.
- Affected/fixed: Versions before 10.5.67; fixed in 10.5.67.
- Source: [Ubiquiti Security Advisory Bulletin 067](https://community.ui.com/releases/r/security/067)

**Finding 5: UniFi Connect Application privilege escalation**

- Product: UniFi Connect Application
- Issue: CVE-2026-77538
- Severity: High, CVSS 8.2
- Summary: A network attacker can exploit improper access control to escalate privileges inside UniFi Connect.
- Relevance: Official UniFi component in the monitored product family.
- Affected/fixed: Versions before 3.24.22; fixed in 3.24.22.
- Source: [Ubiquiti Security Advisory Bulletin 067](https://community.ui.com/releases/r/security/067)

**Finding 6: UniFi OS Server command injection**

- Product: UniFi OS Server
- Issues: CVE-2026-77539, CVE-2026-77540
- Severity: Critical, CVSS 9.1
- Summary: A network attacker with high privileges can exploit input-validation flaws to execute commands on the host.
- Relevance: Official UniFi server component in the monitored product family.
- Affected/fixed: Versions before 5.1.37; fixed in 5.1.37.
- Source: [Ubiquiti Security Advisory Bulletin 067](https://community.ui.com/releases/r/security/067)

**Finding 7: UID Enterprise Agent command injection**

- Product: UID Enterprise Agent
- Issue: CVE-2026-77542
- Severity: Critical, CVSS 9.1
- Summary: A network attacker with high privileges can execute commands on the host through improper input validation.
- Relevance: Ubiquiti lists UID among the official components covered by the UniFi advisory.
- Affected/fixed: Versions before 1.62.1; fixed in 1.62.1.
- Source: [Ubiquiti Security Advisory Bulletin 067](https://community.ui.com/releases/r/security/067)

**Finding 8: UniFi Access command injection and privilege escalation**

- Product: UniFi Access Application
- Issues: CVE-2026-77543, CVE-2026-77546, CVE-2026-77547, CVE-2026-77553
- Severity: Critical, CVSS 9.9
- Summary: Low-privilege network attackers can execute commands or escalate privileges on the host.
- Relevance: Official UniFi component in the monitored product family.
- Affected/fixed: Versions before 4.3.5; fixed in 4.3.5.
- Source: [Ubiquiti Security Advisory Bulletin 067](https://community.ui.com/releases/r/security/067)

**Finding 9: UniFi Connect Display Cast Pro privilege escalation**

- Product: UniFi Connect Display Cast Pro
- Issue: CVE-2026-77551
- Severity: Critical, CVSS 9.0
- Summary: A network attacker can escalate privileges on the device under the conditions stated by the vendor.
- Relevance: Official UniFi component in the monitored product family.
- Affected/fixed: Versions before 1.0.111; fixed in 1.0.111.
- Source: [Ubiquiti Security Advisory Bulletin 067](https://community.ui.com/releases/r/security/067)

**Finding 10: UniFi Enterprise Audio/Video Bridge command injection**

- Product: UniFi Enterprise Audio/Video Bridge
- Issue: CVE-2026-77552
- Severity: Critical, CVSS 9.8
- Summary: A network attacker can execute commands on the device through improper input validation.
- Relevance: Official UniFi component in the monitored product family.
- Affected/fixed: Versions before 1.0.11; fixed in 1.0.11.
- Source: [Ubiquiti Security Advisory Bulletin 067](https://community.ui.com/releases/r/security/067)

**Finding 11: UniFi Talk command injection**

- Product: UniFi Talk Application
- Issue: CVE-2026-77554
- Severity: Critical, CVSS 10.0
- Summary: A network attacker can execute commands on the host through improper input validation.
- Relevance: Official UniFi component in the monitored product family.
- Affected/fixed: Versions before 5.3.2; fixed in 5.3.2.
- Source: [Ubiquiti Security Advisory Bulletin 067](https://community.ui.com/releases/r/security/067)

**Finding 12: UniFi Protect AI Key privilege escalation**

- Product: UniFi Protect AI Key
- Issue: CVE-2026-77557
- Severity: Critical, CVSS 9.8
- Summary: A network attacker can exploit improper access control to escalate privileges on the device.
- Relevance: Official UniFi Protect component in the monitored product family.
- Affected/fixed: Versions before 2.2.6; fixed in 2.2.6.
- Source: [Ubiquiti Security Advisory Bulletin 067](https://community.ui.com/releases/r/security/067)

**Finding 13: Ubuntu OpenJDK 25 security update**

- Product: OpenJDK 25 on Ubuntu 22.04, 24.04, and 26.04 LTS
- Issues: CVE-2026-46968, CVE-2026-46917, CVE-2026-47010, CVE-2026-47021, CVE-2026-47059, CVE-2026-47027, CVE-2026-60147, CVE-2026-47063, CVE-2026-41254
- Severity: Not stated in the Ubuntu notice
- Summary: Canonical's new package notice addresses JSSE authentication/authorization flaws, ImageIO and 2D authorization issues, library and security-component weaknesses, and an integer-arithmetic denial-of-service condition in Little CMS.
- Relevance: OpenJDK and Ubuntu are explicitly monitored. This is a fresh Ubuntu package advisory for previously disclosed upstream CVEs.
- Affected/fixed: Ubuntu packages are updated to OpenJDK 25.0.4+7.
- Source: [Ubuntu USN-8681-1](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8681-1)

**Finding 14: Ubuntu Oracle-cloud kernel update**

- Product: Ubuntu 26.04 LTS linux-oracle kernel
- Issue: CVE-2026-64531
- Severity: High, CVSS 3.1 score 7.8 (Ubuntu)
- Summary: Oversized nested Open vSwitch actions can cause length truncation and later misinterpretation of action data, potentially compromising the system.
- Relevance: Ubuntu is explicitly monitored. This is a fresh Oracle-cloud kernel package update for a previously disclosed CVE.
- Affected/fixed: Fixed in linux-oracle 7.0.0-1010.10 packages.
- Source: [Ubuntu USN-8659-4](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8659-4) and [Ubuntu CVE record](https://ubuntu.com/security/CVE-2026-64531)

**MongoDB ecosystem check**

MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, mongod, mongos, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, mongosh, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, drivers, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, MongoDB-owned alerts, CVE/NVD, GitHub advisories, CISA sources, and credible research were checked. No credible MongoDB-related vulnerability was newly published or substantively updated in the window.

**Freshness notes**

Apache Tomcat's ten-CVE disclosure was timestamped 2026-08-25 22:01 UTC, which was 1 hour 39 minutes before this run's cutoff, so it was excluded. Adobe XD, Veeam, PostgreSQL, Firefox, NGINX, and Apache HTTP Server candidates were also excluded because their upstream disclosures were older or their precise publication time could not be verified inside the window.

Immediate review is recommended for every Ubiquiti/UniFi deployment, prioritizing the unauthenticated CVSS 10.0 paths and externally reachable management networks. The two Ubuntu notices should be reviewed where the named OpenJDK 25 or linux-oracle packages are deployed.
